summary: Conversation message from a user, assistant, or system, with composable author, status, content, and actions.
whenToUse: Showing partial content and keeping it available after an error.
whenNotToUse: Replacing the transport logic or conversation history.

props.name: speaker
props.description: Semantic identity and visual variant. Default names are localized.

props.name: avatar
props.description: Decorative avatar; the name stays in the text.

props.name: status
props.description: Status provided by the consumer; does not start generation.

props.name: statusText
props.description: Status or error text; localized default.

props.name: footer
props.description: Sources, feedback, copy, or consumer actions.

props.name: children
props.description: Text or safe React components; no Markdown parser included.

inherits: HTML attributes of article, aria-label, className, style, and an HTMLElement ref.

keyboard.action: Reaches any actions and links in the footer.

accessibility: Streaming content is aria-busy, not a live region that announces every token.
Status uses role=status; errors use role=alert.
Does not add automatic focus or scrolling.
responsive: Long text and newlines wrap within the container.
customization: data-speaker and data-status distinguish variants and states.
Surface and color tokens also follow nested providers.
commonMistakes: Treating the assistant label as a guarantee of accuracy.
limits: No Markdown, streaming transport, storage, or virtualization.
The consumer defines how the completed response is announced and the scrolling strategy.
